annotations.title: Scan Multi-Chain EVM Portfolio Dust & Allowances

description: Scan an EVM wallet across up to 8 chains (`base`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `bsc`, `linea`, `avalanche`) to discover all ERC-20 token holdings priced in USD, identify sweepable non-stablecoin dust tokens, and summarize open unlimited router approvals. Read-only, zero-connect multi-chain portfolio lookup with unlimited free calls. Returns JSON with `address`, `total_sweepable_usd`, `stable_balances_usd`, per-token `holdings` (`token_address`, `symbol`, `amount_raw`, `usd_value`, `network`), and `approval_risks`. Use this tool to discover token balances and `amount_raw` before calling `build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep`, `build_cross_chain_consolidation`, or `build_erc20_approval_revoke`.

address.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM wallet address (`0x...`) to scan for ERC-20 dust balances and open router allowances.

networks.description: Comma-separated list of EVM networks to scan (choose from `base`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `bsc`, `linea`, `avalanche`).

name: scan_evm_dust_and_hygiene
